set system host-name DeviceC.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set routing-instances vpn1.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing instance named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing for separate routing tables and protocols within that instance.

parameters.name: routing-instance
parameters.explanation: Name of route example, e.g. net.

instance-type vrf.explanation: Configure the type of route example that is a virtual router.

parameters.name: instance-type
parameters.explanation: Type of route example, e.g. virtual-router.

parameters.name: route-distinguisher
parameters.explanation: Routers, used to distinguish between different VPN routes.

vrf-target export target:100:1.explanation: Configures the export target of the VRF.

parameters.name: vrf-target
parameters.explanation: Specifies the export target for VRF.

vrf-target import target:100:1.explanation: Configures the import target for VRF.

parameters.name: vrf-target
parameters.explanation: Specifies the import target for VRF.

protocols bgp group external-peers.explanation: Configure BGP groups in route examples.

type external.explanation: Configure the type of BGP group to be external.

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: Type of BGP group, for example, external.

peer-as 200.explanation: Configure the AS number of the BGP equivalent in the route example.

neighbor 10.1.2.2.explanation: Configure the neighbors of the BGP team.

routing-options static route 192.168.3.3.explanation: Configures the static path and discards the matching path.

parameters.name: route
parameters.explanation: The purpose address of the static route.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: An operation to match the route, for example, discard.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.2.3/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: Autonomy system number for equipment, used for route agreements such as BGP.
